01-inline-selection-capture.tabTitle: Notes on Quiet Software and Durable Attention
01-inline-selection-capture.headline: Notes on Quiet Software and Durable Attention
01-inline-selection-capture.byline: By Linnea Park · linnea@fieldnotes.studio · 6 min read
paragraphs: Software ages well when it leaves the reader's desk uncluttered. Most reading utilities fail not from missing features, but because every capture asks for folders, tags, and account logins before a single sentence has been saved.
Small single-purpose tools behave more like a pocket notebook: you highlight the exact sentence worth keeping, attach it to your running list, and stay inside the essay you came to read.
Local browser storage keeps that loop instantaneous. Excerpts land as plain Markdown lines ready for morning synthesis without background sync queues or telemetry.

04-quick-note-composer.headline: Paper Margins and Digital Annotation
articleParagraphs: Printed books taught generations of readers to think in the margin. A pencil line in the gutter captures an immediate reaction without turning reading into a filing chore.
Digital clippers often over-correct by importing entire stylesheets, images, and navigation menus. Collecting only the chosen sentence preserves the original clarity of thought.

01-inline-selection-capture.headline: 安静软件与持久注意力笔记
01-inline-selection-capture.byline: 作者：Linnea Park · linnea@fieldnotes.studio · 阅读约 6 分钟
paragraphs: 真正耐用的软件从不占据读者的桌面焦点。许多剪藏工具之所以半途而废，并不是功能太少，而是在存下第一句话之前就迫使人建文件夹、填标签与登录账号。
轻巧的单用途工具更像随身笔记本：划选真正值得保留的那一句，顺手收进当下列表，视线依然停留在正在阅读的文章里。
浏览器本地存储让这套循环几乎零延迟。每条摘录都会整理成干净的 Markdown 列表，无需后台同步队列也能随时导出梳理。

04-quick-note-composer.headline: 纸页留白与数字批注
articleParagraphs: 纸质书教会了几代读者在页边思考。铅笔在栏边画下的一道短线，能立即留住灵感，而不必把阅读变成繁琐的归档劳动。
许多网页剪藏插件常把整套样式表、广告图和导航栏一起抓下来；只收下你真正选中的那几句话，反而能保留思考原本的清澈。
